items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: We had, in the band at that time, we had ... Emmett, the guy who played guitar by the name of Emmett.

ctx.x: That's all I know, Nene. And I played there. We had, in the band at that time, we had Tick Chambers, Ernest Kelly. Ernest Johnson, a little fella they call Duck Ernest, I guess you heard of him. Mm-hmm. And Emmett, the guy who played guitar by the name of Emmett. I don't know, I can't think of his last name, Emmett. And a fella by the name of Roy Palmer, trombone. Oh, yeah, you played with Roy.
I know him in Chicago, yeah. Roy Palmer.
